supersedes.reason: Binds current manifest-v3/checkpoint-v4 runner provenance, normalization, validation feedback, recovery, provider artifacts, and session commitments.

dataset.name: HANNA: Human and AI Generated Narrative Assessment
dataset.license_attribution: HANNA benchmark repository, dig-team/hanna-benchmark-asg, MIT License.
dataset.retrieval: Direct pinned raw GitHub files only; no archive download or expansion.
dataset.raw_prose_policy: External work directory only; no HANNA story or prompt prose is committed or published.

selection.stratification: Hash and split unique prompt strings before inspecting ratings. Within partition and Model, rank by three-rater six-dimension mean then Story ID; choose two items per partition-relative rank quartile.

weight_profile.policy: This published alignment study uses the exact default HBQ-RS weights; custom profiles are outside the frozen protocol.

runner.checkpoint_contract: manifest-v3/checkpoint-v4 with evidence normalization, feedback-bound cumulative retries, repaired-output replay, accepted provider artifacts, and provider session commitments.
runner.resume: Only an identical frozen existing run may resume. A fresh repetition may contain several batch sessions, but its complete session set must be globally disjoint from every other repetition.

repeatability.items: One deterministic development story per Model, fixed before execution.

metrics.primary: Six confirmatory Spearman correlations and macro mean with 1,000 prompt-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals.

human_ratings_policy: Use only already-published HANNA ratings and published agreement context. This study never recruits, contacts, or newly judges human readers.
published_human_agreement_context: The HANNA paper reports ICC(2,k) values in the fair-to-moderate range (approximately .29 to .56) across its dimensions; cite the paper rather than treating this study's selected-slice statistic as a ceiling.
